hebrewText: יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה כָּב֑וֹד וּ/תְהִלָּת֖/וֹ בָּ/אִיִּ֥ים יַגִּֽידוּ

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island

properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
tokens.kjv: bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.
tokens.explanation: nagad — anunciar, declarar, dizer, contar, revelar
